author: Desmond
description: Strip all roles when a BAN role is applied; run a configurable command (e.g. Verify) on removal. Includes ban/unban/banlist commands with reasons, day-based durations with auto-expiry, and per-guild permissions.
install_msg: Thank you for installing BanStrip. Get started with `[p]banstrip role <role>` and `[p]banstrip toggle true`.
name: BanStrip
short: BAN-role jail with ban/unban/banlist and verify-on-unban
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores, per guild and user, the reason, who banned, and ban timestamps for members banned via `[p]banstrip ban`. This data is removed when the BAN role is removed or on request.
